parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPN gateway instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPN gateway.
